dishes.name: Sivas kofte
dishes.desc: Simple meatballs grilled over wood fire, served on pide with roasted pepper and tomato. A product with a geographical indication and the city's best-known dish.

dishes.name: Hingel
dishes.desc: Large pieces of filled dough, boiled and served with garlicky yogurt and butter. Sivas's own version of mantı, usually filled with potato or cheese.

dishes.name: Divrigi pilaf
dishes.desc: A rich pilaf with meat, rice, chickpeas and dried fruit, cooked for special occasions. It comes from Divriği, in the east of the province.

dishes.name: Madimak
dishes.desc: A wild herb chopped and cooked with bulgur, onion and garlic, sometimes with pastirma. A spring dish tied to Sivas.

dishes.name: Erzincan tulum cheese
dishes.desc: A crumbly cheese from sheep and goat milk of the high pastures, matured in skin bags for about three months. It carries Turkish and EU geographical indications.
